name: mcp.calendar.update
rests_on: agents-calendar CLI update VEVENT; extra argv is href etag then optional fields; dtstart and dtend are ISO-8601 with a UTC offset (a time without an offset is treated as UTC); exit 0 = updated

dtstart.description: Optional new start, ISO-8601 with a UTC offset (e.g. 2026-11-29T16:00:00+01:00). A time without an offset is treated as UTC.

dtend.description: Optional new end, ISO-8601 with a UTC offset (e.g. 2026-11-29T17:00:00+01:00). A time without an offset is treated as UTC.
